parsed.rationale: All four records in this cluster belong to the same logical type, `PlaybackReason`, spread intentionally across packages as a core type-alias declaration in `Playback/PlaybackCore/PlaybackReason.swift` plus purpose-specific extensions in `PlayerHeaderView` (`PlaybackReason+PlayerHeaderView.swift`) and the app target (`WXYC/iOS/PlaybackReason+App.swift`). This is the standard Swift pattern of declaring a type once and extending it per-consumer package; the 'name collision' signal is a structural artefact of that pattern, not evidence of unintended duplication. No context flags (`is_test`, `is_mock`, `is_sample_app`, `is_codegen`) are set, but the structural evidence fields (`jaccard`, `shared_field_count`, `differing_slots`) are all null, meaning there is no field-level overlap to consolidate. Recommending any merge or extraction would collapse intentional per-layer separation.
